topic: Reviewing router data and channel overlap
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing network data from routers where a firmware update was applied. Specifically, the goal is to determine if neighboring channels were captured and whether the volume of data differed compared to routers without the change.

[me] stated that a superficial review had been conducted, but deeper investigation into the data gaps (intervals) was required.
action_items: Investigate router data for neighboring channels and data volume differences.
